title: Latent operator induction without operator-ID query dispatch
question: Can the multimodal PLM infer which fixed Boolean primitive to execute from unlabeled truth-table demonstrations, when the operator ID is absent from the query?
hypothesis: The integrated PLM will infer the hidden operator from the registered demonstration context and achieve the registered q2 threshold on the held-out compositions without receiving the operator ID.
held_constant: same text/image/audio payload encoder and residual-linear persistent-state write as E2E-008
same five seeds, optimizer, learning rate, weight decay, 300 training steps and batch size 96
same explicit entity IDs and target bit indices; entity addressing is intentionally not tested here
same collision-free payload-only modality generator as E2E-008
fixed Boolean primitives remain the execution library; only the operator-ID selection scaffold is removed
support truth table contains four rows for the hidden operator and row order is randomized
the hidden operator label is never supplied to the model or used as an auxiliary training target
no post-run model selection or tuning
leakage_rules: held-out target compositions are excluded from training
evaluation is generated after training from a separate RNG namespace
training/evaluation semantic overlap must be zero
operator ID is absent from the model's query and operator-induction inputs
operator labels are used only for benchmark generation and post-hoc diagnostic scoring, never as model training targets
support row order is randomized independently per episode
operator induction module must receive gradient from q2 task loss
benchmark generator hash and base E2E-008 generator hash are pinned
all evaluation seeds have distinct fingerprints

arms.name: normal_latent_operator
arms.intervention: infer operator weights from support truth-table context; no operator ID is passed to query

arms.name: oracle_operator
arms.intervention: same model and state read but override inferred operator with the hidden operator ID

arms.name: shuffle_support_labels
arms.intervention: rotate support labels across demonstration rows while preserving input pairs and label marginals

arms.name: no_memory
arms.intervention: zero persistent state before q2 while retaining the same support context

decision_rule.condition: all integrity gates pass; normal mean heldout q2 accuracy >=0.80; every seed q2 >=0.40; normal operator-selection accuracy mean >=0.90 and every seed >=0.80
decision_rule.licenses: bounded evidence that the model can infer and apply the hidden operator on the registered synthetic multimodal task without an operator-ID query channel
decision_rule.does_not_license: operator synthesis outside the fixed primitive library; learned semantic addressing; real-world multimodal competence; scaling

decision_rule.condition: integrity passes but q2 or operator-selection thresholds fail
decision_rule.licenses: the latent-operator capability criterion is not established on this benchmark
decision_rule.does_not_license: architecture impossibility or general operator-induction impossibility

interpretation_order: benchmark identity and held-out composition exclusion
oracle upper bound and action-decision consistency
